links.outcome: Sensitivity for CIN 2+ with conventional colposcopy vs AI alone vs AI-assisted colposcopy
links.effect: CIN 2+ sensitivity was 96.0% for AI colposcopy and 100% for AI-assisted colposcopy vs 85.9% for conventional colposcopy (P=.026, P<.001). AI flagged 77.6% of women as positive vs 47.5% conventionally.
links.quote: The sensitivity for detecting CIN 2+ was significantly higher for AI colposcopy (96.0%) and AI-assisted colposcopy (100%) than for conventional colposcopy (85.9%, P =.026, P <.001, respectively).

screen.reason: The study evaluates a real-world clinical deployment of an AI-assisted colposcopy tool, comparing clinician alone (conventional colposcopy) versus AI-assisted clinician performance during patient examinations and biopsy decisions.
